_comment: Each firm capability or profile item pointed at the ESCO (European Commission skills classification) skills that mean the same thing. Looked up in ESCO's public search on 2026-10-14 and reviewed by hand: a close-but-wrong match is worse than none. 'no_match' says why nothing fits, so a gap in the public vocabulary is visible instead of silently papered over.

Agile / Transformation.note: Covers Agile only; ESCO has no transformation-programme skill.

Commercial Banking.note: ESCO does not split retail, commercial and core banking, so both map to the same skill.

Data & AI / GenAI.note: Partial: nothing in ESCO names generative AI, so the part the firm wants most is not in the public vocabulary.

Claude Cowork / GenAI tooling.no_match: ESCO has no skill for generative-AI tools; searching 'generative AI' returned unrelated skills.

Cloud Architecture.note: Technology awareness only; ESCO has no architecture-design skill for cloud.

Security Clearance.no_match: A government vetting status, not a skill; ESCO does not model it.
